newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran cuts off four fingers of habitual thief.
newsitem.headline: Iran cuts off four fingers of habitual thief.

text.p: An Iranian man convicted 12 times of stealing was punished by having the four fingers of his right hand cut off, a newspaper said on Wednesday.
The daily Kayhan said the amputation was carried out at the Tehran criminal police headquarters on Tuesday after the Supreme Court upheld a lower court sentence against the repeat offender.
The man was taken to hospital after the four fingers of his right hand were cut off, leaving only the thumb, in line with Iran's Islamic penal code, the evening newspaper added.
